what_happened: Two Oracle dispatches (ses_ef6949c5cffelnSnEpGX96d5G2, ses_ef693ca76ffenCkcItURiZN73k) both terminated with 'Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media' before returning any analysis. First attempt pointed Oracle at a 263 KB reference file by mistake; second attempt imposed a strict 5-file read limit and still overflowed.
root_cause: First: orchestrator included ce_task_reference.py (263 KB, single-line-heavy Python) in the read list. Second: residual session/system context plus allowed evidence files exceeded the Oracle session compaction limit; failure is environmental, not a rejection of the review request.
what_i_did_wrong: Issued a review prompt referencing a 263 KB file without checking its size, then retried without first measuring whether the failure was systemic to oracle sessions.
impact: No prompt-neutrality review obtained. Assessment task construction proceeded with orchestrator self-review only unless a third adjusted attempt or an alternative reviewer succeeds.
preventive: Check file sizes before naming files in a delegation prompt. After two environmental dispatch failures on the same specialist, stop retrying that specialist and switch reviewers.
